quest.emeraldweapons.arcencium.title: Your first Arcencium
quest.emeraldweapons.arcencium.how: Dig below level zero, deeper than diamond. A diamond pickaxe yields raw ore; an iron pickaxe only chips shards, four shards make one raw. Wait for the Aurora: it shows veins through rock.
quest.emeraldweapons.lingot.title: Three ingots
quest.emeraldweapons.lingot.how: Smelt the raw ore in an ordinary furnace. All the mode's gear is made of Arcencium ingots.
quest.emeraldweapons.recipe.ingot: Raw Arcencium → furnace → Arcencium Ingot (one for one; the ore drops two raw)
quest.emeraldweapons.prisme.title: Prism wood
quest.emeraldweapons.prisme.how: Every weapon needs a branch, every armour piece a fibre. Prism Trees grow in groves in plains and forests; the village defence gave you some, and sanctuary chests carry them.
quest.emeraldweapons.recipe.prism: Log → 4 crystal planks; 2 planks → 4 branches; 3 leaves → 1 fibre
quest.emeraldweapons.arme.title: Your first weapon
quest.emeraldweapons.arme.how: On an ordinary crafting table, with ingots, emeralds and prism. Four weapons, each with its own mechanic:
quest.emeraldweapons.recipe.legend: A Arcencium ingot · E emerald · B Prism branch · F Prism fibre · N diamond sword · R plain bow · . empty
quest.emeraldweapons.forge.title: The Forge: +1
quest.emeraldweapons.forge.how: At the village's Arcencium Forge: place the piece, carry a Forge Stone and the tier's metal (4 iron for +1). A failure never lowers the piece; up to +7 it refunds the metal and only costs the Stone.
quest.emeraldweapons.rune.title: Engrave a rune
quest.emeraldweapons.rune.how: At the Socket Bench: place the piece, place a rune beside it, take the piece back. Weapon runes go on the weapon or the helmet; armour runes on armour. A rune's rank cannot exceed the piece's rarity.
quest.emeraldweapons.rarete.title: Raise the rarity
quest.emeraldweapons.rarete.how: At the Socket Bench: place the piece, place Fate Shards beside it, take the piece back. The die is rolled when you take it; more Shards, better odds, and what you already spent on this piece stays yours.
quest.emeraldweapons.specialisation.how: At the village's Specialisation Altar, with Arcencium feathers: +1 costs three feathers and always succeeds. Your wings appear, and this progress survives the game.
quest.emeraldweapons.tombeau.title: Wake a seal
quest.emeraldweapons.tombeau.how: In a sanctuary, five seals sleep in the pyramid and its wings. Click one to wake it. All awake, the summit anchor accepts Arcencium.
quest.emeraldweapons.ancre.title: Hold an anchor
quest.emeraldweapons.ancre.how: At the sanctuary's summit, feed the anchor Arcencium ingots (8 for the first) and hold the siege. Three anchors held raise the Rainbow and its boss.

game.emeraldweapons.haven.agenda.partie: The game is on. The end of the Challenge brings you back to Haven.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.agenda.ferme: The city is closed for now.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.agenda.etape.s: Haven's heroes have quests for you: talk to them (right-click).
game.emeraldweapons.haven.agenda.recu: You received your diary: open it (right-click) to read your next appointment.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.parcours.reuni: Which mode do you want to play?
Vote at the kiosk at the end of the counter: blue pane for the Open world, red pane for the Challenge. We leave once the whole team has voted.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.parcours.objec: At HQ: the team is coming (%s of %s)
socket.emeraldweapons.upgrade.kept.metal: Failed. The gear stays at +%s; the Stone and the metal are lost.
upgrade.emeraldweapons.risk.metal: A failure takes the Stone and the metal
item.emeraldweapons.arcencium_shield.par: Instant parry: blocks as soon as it is raised
item.emeraldweapons.arcencium_shield.rip: Prismatic riposte: a blocked hit returns one heart of damage and knocks back (once per second)
weather.emeraldweapons.aurore.cold: The Great Cold is setting in: take shelter under a roof, underground or near a fire.
weather.emeraldweapons.aurore.cold.froze: You are freezing! Underground, under a roof or near a fire, quick.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.depart.open: The portal to the village is open at HQ: walk through the arch when you are ready.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.depart.reminde: The HQ arch leads to the village (%s of %s already gone).
game.emeraldweapons.haven.depart.late: The portal is closing: off to the village.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.faune.armee: The seagulls strike back! Take cover.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.faune.large: Open sea: sharks and jellyfish lurk here. The harbour basin is safe.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.agenda.rdv.dep: Departure: walk through the HQ arch to reach the village.
quete.emeraldweapons.rues.desc: With the team, kill the monsters that invaded Haven during the Challenge.
quete.emeraldweapons.patrouille.desc: Visit the city's twelve eco points within ten minutes, with the city invaded.
quete.emeraldweapons.port.desc: Hold the harbor square against the monsters for a minute. The contract can be redone, and it pays every time.
quete.emeraldweapons.chasse.desc: Kill twenty-five monsters with the Scatter Gun, with the city invaded.
quete.emeraldweapons.brutes.desc: Three armored brutes prowl around Sig's square: take them down within six minutes.
quete.emeraldweapons.marche.desc: The market is crawling with monsters: kill them all within five minutes.
quete.emeraldweapons.anneaux.desc: Behind the wheel, pass the ten rings of the high lane in order, within two and a half minutes of the first.
quete.emeraldweapons.taxi.desc: Pick up a citizen waiting on a square and drop them off at the other end of the city within three minutes.
quete.emeraldweapons.chauffard.desc: A crazed car is causing panic: ram it three times within three minutes.
quete.emeraldweapons.tir1.desc: One minute at Tess's shooting range: shoot the cardboard KG guards, not the civilians. Bronze, silver, gold.
quete.emeraldweapons.tir2.desc: The targets slide sideways: one minute to shoot down as many as you can.
quete.emeraldweapons.tir3.desc: Distant targets that don't stay long: one minute to aim true.
quete.emeraldweapons.ecos.desc: Touch red, yellow, blue and dark eco without dying, with the city invaded.
quete.emeraldweapons.plateforme.desc: Hold the west tower terrace for a minute against the waves of monsters.
quete.emeraldweapons.elite.desc: Three waves of monsters on Samos's terrace, then their leader: an elite in netherite armor.
quete.emeraldweapons.peche.desc: Catch two hundred pounds of fish in the city's waters, with the Fisherman's rod.
quete.emeraldweapons.coffres.desc: Six chests lie at the bottom, three in the basin and three out at sea: open them within ten minutes. Beware of sharks.
quete.emeraldweapons.mouettes.desc: The dock gulls steal the Fisherman's fish: take down ten of them. Each one calls its army…
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.parle.to: This city won't defend itself. I've got work for you.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.parle.te: Welcome to the gun room! Targets to shoot, and wonders for sale.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.parle.si: Streets full of monsters? I love it. Coming hunting?
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.parle.ke: My cars are itching to go. Show me what you can do behind the wheel.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.parle.sa: Eco flows through this city, young hero. Learn to master it.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.parle.pe: Those blasted gulls steal all my fish! Will you help me?
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.verrou.r: Come back when the streets have been retaken.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.rues.a_f: on returning from the Challenge, with the team
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.bouton.b: Tess's shop: weapons, unlimited eco, Challenge bonuses
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.bouton.c: A combat quest is under way: the city stays invaded until it ends.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.propose: %s is starting "%s" for %s. Join the team?
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.refus.vi: Quests take place in Haven, while the city is open.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.refus.oc: You're already on "%s": finish it or give it up first.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.refus.ru: The streets are retaken on returning from the Challenge, with the team.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.invasion: "%s": monsters invade Haven for the duration of the quest!
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.maitrise: Mastery! All twelve weapons and every quest: the HQ button obeys you.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.echec.zo: "%s": the position fell, nobody was holding it.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.echec.mo: "%s": a team member fell. Start again!
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.echec.sc: "%s": not enough targets for bronze. Try again!
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.echec.ca: "%s" can't take place: the city map is missing.

game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.taxi.che: Pick up the passenger at %s: stop next to them
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.chauffar: The reckless driver has been spotted: follow the red beam!
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.tir.pret: Ready? Bronze at %s, silver at %s, gold at %s points. Civilians cost two points!
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.tir.alle: Join Tess at the shooting range
game.emeraldweapons.haven.quete.peche.ca: The Fisherman lends you his rod: good fishing!
game.emeraldweapons.haven.orbe.tous: All %s hidden orbs of Haven are yours!
game.emeraldweapons.haven.carte.perimee: This card is no longer valid.

game.emeraldweapons.haven.boutique.provi: On your next departure: sixteen steaks, eight golden carrots and two golden apples.

game.emeraldweapons.haven.agenda.rdv.que: Talk to Haven's heroes: they have quests for you.
game.emeraldweapons.haven.agenda.bonus.a: Nothing yet: Tess's shop is in the gun room.
